axes.native_validity: Is the exact statement proved for the actual source and carrier?
axes.closing_relevance: Would it supply an opposing estimate strong enough to contradict the generated state?

rule: Every proposed closing premise has a named record. A true identity can supply no restriction; a strong-looking bound can be false for the actual source. Local Linux compilation is development evidence until current-head CI accepts the source.

constraints.name: (C1) cofinal vanishing-error moment-slice bounds
constraints.statement: For every n>=1 there is an aperture L>=n+2 and one parity whose entire moment slice at K=originalDetectorQuarticCutoff(L) satisfies Q_p(L,x) >= -(1/n)||x||^2 in the inherited physical norm.
constraints.scope: Actual canonical source; actual even/odd pole-neutral carriers with physical M4=0 (even) or M3=M5=0 (odd); literal quartic cutoff.
constraints.parameter_order: n first; then L and the parity; then every slice vector. No fixed parity, rank, gap or bound between selected apertures.
constraints.budget_improved: Would discharge the closing premise directly.

constraints.name: Selected-packet ground-response restriction
constraints.statement: At late disjoint native states at the literal quartic cutoff, the corrected cubic source on the strictly lower negative even ground ray and the odd adjoint pairing on the strictly lower negative odd ground ray are both below one.
constraints.scope: Same states as the actual generated packets; packet-uniform and one-output forms are also consumed.
constraints.parameter_order: R before L; the restriction must hold on the eligible packet outputs themselves or one output must carry both packet properties and the restriction.
constraints.budget_improved: Removes the separate global shared-ground exclusion and the all-cutoff uniformity of EventualNegativeGroundClosure.

constraints.name: (C2) actual long-term eventual lower bound
constraints.statement: There exist C>0 and T such that for all t>=T, hyperbolaT(actualCorrelationLogarithmicTest t)(actualCorrelationCutoff t/2) >= -C.
constraints.scope: Literal correlation source H=kappa*kappa, genuine Mobius coefficients, natural half-history cutoff.
constraints.parameter_order: C and T before every t.
constraints.budget_improved: Equivalent (proved) to the rank-one-plus-off-diagonal sqrt lower target after the controlled diagonal.

constraints.name: Native K3 ordinary-prime remainder E_ord
constraints.statement: An eventual polynomial lower bound on either literal K3 scalar energy, equivalently control of E_ord = B_1 + 200 a beta^2 L + d_0 (H_2+16) L^2.
constraints.scope: Fixed K=3 native vectors; different carriers from the quartic slices.
constraints.parameter_order: Eventual in L; constants independent of L.
constraints.budget_improved: Would close via the DERIVED fixed-K3 Landau argument, which is not formalized.

constraints.name: Qualified causal alternative
constraints.statement: The actual source-preserving causal Gram residual tends to zero.
constraints.scope: Actual dependent source packet.
constraints.budget_improved: Independent OR branch.

constraints.name: Fixed off-line-zero margin on both moment slices
constraints.statement: Under an actual off-line zero there is d>0 such that eventually both slices contain nonzero literal trials with Q_p < -d||x||^2.
constraints.scope: Literal trial vectors, not ground eigenvectors.
constraints.budget_improved: Fixes the margin any supplier must beat.

constraints.name: Exact slice dimensions and nonvacuity
constraints.statement: dim even slice = K-3 and dim odd slice = K-4 (natural subtraction) for K>=2; at K=ceil(L^4)>=16 the slices have dimension at least 13 and 12.
constraints.scope: Actual carriers.
constraints.budget_improved: Prevents vacuous small-cutoff evidence; at K=3 the even slice bound holds for every tolerance.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: Physical congruence transport and frame comparisons
constraints.statement: Slice bounds are exactly seed-coordinate bounds with the full Gram D^2; a coordinate tolerance eps gives physical eps/beta^2; a physical tolerance eps gives coordinate eps (beta+K^2)^2.
constraints.scope: Fixed seed chart x=Dy, D=(L/(4pi))^2+n^2.
constraints.budget_improved: Exact tolerance conversion for finite certificates.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: Disjoint spectra exclude every bottom tie
constraints.statement: Where the full even and odd native spectra are disjoint, the two Rayleigh bottoms differ.
constraints.scope: Any native state; supplied at the actual packet detector cutoff by the production packet theorem.
constraints.budget_improved: The packet route needs only the two ground tests.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: Inverse-residual block certificate (C3)
constraints.statement: A >= a > 0 and D - CX - X*C* + X*AX - a^{-1} R*R >= 0 with R = C* - AX imply the complete block is PSD; the exact form identity with A^{-1} holds.
constraints.scope: Arbitrary complex inner-product spaces; no native data.
constraints.budget_improved: Retains full coupling; the scalar inverse-gap surrogate is its X=0 case.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: Finite source-core consumer (C4)
constraints.statement: Leakage eta <= eps/4 against the full complement and core form >= -(11 eps/12) imply H + eps I >= 0; column form keeps the nonorthogonal Gram.
constraints.scope: Arbitrary self-adjoint operator.
constraints.budget_improved: Sound reduction of a physical shift to a core certificate; the signed core premise is OPEN.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: Negative-witness transport (E2)
constraints.statement: A trial with margin d and leakage eta < d/3 has a nonzero projected core component with margin d - 3 eta.
constraints.scope: Arbitrary self-adjoint operator.
constraints.budget_improved: Paid compression keeps the obstruction visible on the core.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.statement: A_Gamma(L) > 0 for every L > 0.
constraints.scope: Six external Lean files; not in production ROOTS.

constraints.scope: Finite Hermitian matrix with selected columns.

constraints.name: Universal approximate-kernel mixed estimate

constraints.scope: November 7 reports.
constraints.budget_improved: Not a prerequisite for the finite core investigation.

constraints.name: Fixed fractional saving against the positive K3 sector
constraints.statement: B_1 >= -kappa (A_Gamma + B_{>=2}) eventually with fixed kappa < 1.
constraints.scope: Native K3.
constraints.budget_improved: Too strong even under RH.

constraints.name: Pole channel vanishes on both carriers
constraints.statement: The pole kernel is S(u u^T - v v^T) with u_n = L/d_n and v_n = 4 pi n/d_n; parity kills one profile and pole neutrality the other, so the pole energy is identically zero on both pole-neutral carriers. The native energy there is exactly -arch - prime.
constraints.scope: Every L, K; both parities.
constraints.budget_improved: Removes the pole channel from every signed budget on the carriers; enclosures [+/- 1e-55] at every replayed state.

formalization.added: odd profile orthogonality, odd-carrier operator annihilation, sesquilinear vanishing on both carriers, exact native energy identities and slice-bound equivalences

constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: Channel-separated supplier
constraints.statement: lambda_min(-arch) + lambda_min(-prime) >= -1/n on the slice.
constraints.scope: Replayed L = 4, 5, 6.
constraints.budget_improved: Even-slice minima: -arch -1.354/-1.719/-2.084, -prime -3.788/-4.774/-5.366 at L = 4/5/6 (rigorous Rayleigh values); the separated loss grows about linearly in L while the tolerance shrinks.

constraints.name: Scalar inverse-gap supplier on the Fourier-prefix split
constraints.statement: D - a^-1 C C^T >= 0 for some a <= lambda_min(A).
constraints.scope: Replayed L = 4, 5, 6 at the checkpoints and at 1/1024.
constraints.budget_improved: Refuted at all 9 tested points; |witness| times eps = 4.6, 8.7, 13.2 at n = 2, 3, 4, because the complement block carries near-null directions.

constraints.name: Shifted-prefix quarter gap, high-support unshifted gap and upper cap (separate identities)
constraints.statement: lambda_min(A_eps) >= 1/4 persists; A <= 9 persists.
constraints.scope: Replayed L = 4, 5, 6.
constraints.budget_improved: The unshifted complement block has rigorous Rayleigh upper bounds 3.9e-7/6.8e-7 (L = 4), 5.0e-17/1.0e-16 (L = 5) and 8.3e-18/1.4e-17 (L = 6), so no fixed high gap survives as eps decreases; the cap b = 9 fails at L = 5, 6 and is not a hypothesis of the Lean consumer.
constraints.correction: CORRECTIONS R2/R6: version 1 conflated the shifted Fourier-prefix complement with the historical high-support unshifted law and used float-only falsifications. Increment 2B tests SHIFTED_PREFIX_QUARTER_GAP_COORDINATE and HIGH_SUPPORT_UNSHIFTED_SLICE separately with exact witnesses; the historical constant is still not imported. CORRECTIONS R10 (evidence/increment3c/CORRECTIONS_ADDENDUM.json): the HIGH_SUPPORT_UNSHIFTED_SLICE falsification holds only on the support |n| > split at splits 128, 312 and 648 with the constant 1/4; it does not falsify a historical certificate on a narrower support, a higher threshold or another constant. The unshifted Rayleigh bounds in budget_improved are for the Fourier-prefix complement block, not for high support.

constraints.name: Degree-m coupled polynomial certificate at the (C1) checkpoints
constraints.statement: X = P_m(A) C^T in blockEnergy_nonneg_of_inverse_residual_certificate supplies the (C1) checkpoint at a tested degree m(n, L).
constraints.budget_improved: Smallest successful tested degree 4, 8, 16 at n = 2, 3, 4 (L = 4, 5, 6), both parities; the degree law m doubling per checkpoint is an EXPERIMENTAL SIGNAL frozen as P9 for n = 5 (E-H7). E-H7 (n = 5, L = 7, eps = 1/5): P9 CONFIRMED; smallest successful tested degree 32 (even) and 32 (odd).
constraints.correction: CORRECTIONS R5: INVERSE_RESIDUAL and GEOMETRIC_TAIL are distinct families; both are recorded per degree in increment2b and E-D1.

constraints.name: Near-null count law
constraints.statement: The number of slice eigenvalues below a fixed small threshold (1e-2 to 1e-13) equals dim - N(2 pi K/L) up to O(log T).
constraints.budget_improved: EXPERIMENTAL SIGNAL: below 1e-2 the count equals round(dim - N(T)) within 1 at L = 4, 5, 6 in both parities, with about one extra eigenvalue leaving per two decades down to 1e-13. Heuristic origin: the explicit-formula picture. Not a theorem and not RH evidence.
constraints.correction: CORRECTIONS R8: absolute and signed counts recorded separately; comparison is with N_main(T), not a certified zero count.

constraints.name: Near-band coupling mass
constraints.statement: The coupling C from the low slice block into the near-null directions of the complement block (eigenvalues of A within 1e-6 of eps) has total mass far below the scalar-gap charge.
constraints.scope: Fourier-prefix flag at L = 4, 5, 6 checkpoints.
constraints.budget_improved: EXPERIMENTAL SIGNAL: coupling mass about 1e-6 against charges 12, 30 and 60. It explains why scalar-gap suppliers fail while coupled certificates pass. It is not a sign bound: a coupled certificate approximates a negative Schur complement just as faithfully. Increment 3C: certified projector-free upper bounds (trace and lambda_max of C Phi_k C^T) at L = 4, 5, 6 replace the floating projectors as the recorded quantity; e.g. tr M(eps + 1e-6) <= 9.2e-6 at L = 6 even. Synthetic controls show that small coupling is not a sign criterion: a low-band off-line world is certified negative with the same coupling bound (E-OFFLINE-SYN). E-H7: near-band counts 240 / 240, coupling traces 1.05e-06 / 2.06e-06 (P11 CONFIRMED, P12 CONFIRMED; floating projectors).

constraints.name: Detection threshold of off-line quartets at finite checkpoints
constraints.statement: A checkpoint at tolerance eps and aperture L detects an off-line quartet of depth delta iff c(L) delta^2 >~ eps, with c(L) increasing in L.
constraints.scope: Synthetic explicit-formula worlds at L = 4, 5, 6, three ordinate bands, delta in [1/1000, 1/4].
constraints.budget_improved: EXPERIMENTAL SIGNAL: eps*/delta^2 = 9.4, 17.9, 28.2 (low band, delta = 1/1000). Finite checkpoints with c(L) delta^2 < eps are blind (certified: the synthetic delta = 1/10 worlds pass the eps = 1/2 and 1/3 checkpoints). The Lean consumer already proves fixed-margin detection for each actual off-line zero; this records the delta- and L-dependence only. Not RH evidence.

constraints.name: Channel-separable control of -arch and -prime on the near-null subspace
constraints.statement: Bounds -arch >= -kappa_A and -prime >= -kappa_P on V with kappa_A + kappa_P smaller than the required tolerance.
constraints.scope: Native slices at L = 4, 5, 6, both parities.
constraints.budget_improved: EXPERIMENTAL SIGNAL with certified entries: on V each channel has O(1) negative eigenvalues (-arch down to -2.1, -prime down to -5.4) while the joint form is at most 7.5e-3; any channel-separable estimate loses O(1). -arch alone is certified not positive at L = 4, 5.

constraints.name: Stability of slice positivity under prime-cell truncation
constraints.statement: The slice form -arch - prime_{q <= P} stays above -eps for some P < Q.
constraints.scope: L = 4, 5 (certified) and L = 6 (floating).
constraints.budget_improved: Dropping only the largest prime power gives certified negative values (-1.06e-5 / -2.7e-3 at L = 4, -0.216 / -0.271 at L = 5); truncated forms are not native. A supplier must use the whole prime cell; truncation or monotone-in-P arguments are blocked.

constraints.name: Inverse residual dominates the geometric tail at the same exact degree
constraints.proposition: S_IR(X = P_m(A) C^T) - S_tail = C[(q^m I - T^m)/a + (a^-1 I - A^-1)(T^m - T^2m)]C^T
constraints.statement: For 0 < aI <= A <= bI, T = I - A/b, q = 1 - a/b and the exact polynomial action, S_IR - S_tail >= 0.
constraints.scope: Any exact symmetric block pencil; numerically certified at L = 4, 5 (m = 8, 64) and at L = 2 in CI.
constraints.budget_improved: Family ordering only: the inverse-residual certificate is at least as strong as the geometric tail at equal exact degree. It needs the exact P_m(A) (a perturbed X breaks the identity). Lean formalization deferred behind the signed-source work, as the review advised.

constraints.name: Compressed commutator with all leakage terms
constraints.statement: [Vᴴ D0 V, Vᴴ E V] = Vᴴ[D0,E]V + Z Lᴴ - L Zᴴ whenever (1 - V Vᴴ) D0 V = W Lᴴ and D0, E are self-adjoint.
constraints.scope: Any finite matrices; the native instantiation (actual carrier basis, D0 = diag(n²), E = canonical source) is not formalized.
constraints.budget_improved: Supplies the geometry-energy commutator with the signed leakage numerator retained (work package F §11.3). It controls neither the diagonal nor the absolute energy; Vᴴ[D0,E]V is not shown to vanish on the actual carrier.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: Exact-data soundness of the shifted-factor certificate
constraints.statement: 0 < tau and ||A - tau I - R Rᵀ||²_F < tau² imply xᵀAx > 0 for x ≠ 0; tau > 0 is necessary.
constraints.scope: Exact real data; the Arb enclosure bridge to the native source is OPEN.
constraints.budget_improved: Level-4 soundness for the kernel decision rule on exact data; the receipts of Increment 3F record tau and the residual bound for every CERTIFIED row.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: Source-column Gram and discarded-sector trace identities
constraints.statement: For C = H S with invertible G = CᴴC: G = Sᴴ H² S, Cᴴ H C = Sᴴ H³ S, P = C G⁻¹ Cᴴ is a self-adjoint idempotent and tr(((1-P)H)ᴴ((1-P)H)) = tr(H²) - tr(G⁻¹ Sᴴ H⁴ S).
constraints.scope: Any finite self-adjoint H; the nonorthogonal-metric version is not formalized.
constraints.budget_improved: Makes the C4 leakage computable from the source columns; no signed-core premise is proved.
constraints.qualification_note: U1 (revision 3): the exact registered statement is qualified at dab9fbe; human release review NOT_ESTABLISHED.

constraints.name: (PG) fixed-parity polynomial lower bound on the moment slices
constraints.statement: Exists a parity p, C > 0, d : Nat and L0 with Q_p(L,u) >= -C (1+L)^d ||u||^2 for every u in M_p(L,K(L)) and every L >= L0.
constraints.scope: Actual quartic cutoff, coefficient physical norm, exact slices.
constraints.parameter_order: parity, C, d, L0 before L and u.
constraints.strength: If the native slice energy is the Weil form on the slice functions, RH implies Q >= 0 there, so this contract is also RH-necessary: a sharp interface (LEAD, not formalized). Only an independent supplier changes the state.
constraints.budget_improved: Permits any fixed polynomial loss instead of a vanishing epsilon.

constraints.name: (SE) fixed-parity subexponential lower bound
constraints.statement: Exists p such that for every alpha > 0 there are C, L0 with Q_p(L,u) >= -C exp(alpha L) ||u||^2 for all L >= L0.
constraints.scope: As CR31.
constraints.parameter_order: parity before alpha; C and L0 after alpha; all late L.
constraints.strength: If the native slice energy is the Weil form on the slice functions, RH implies Q >= 0 there, so this contract is also RH-necessary: a sharp interface (LEAD, not formalized). Only an independent supplier changes the state.
constraints.budget_improved: Every positive exponential rate is affordable.

constraints.name: Fixed-rate partial exclusion
constraints.statement: A fixed-parity bound -C exp(alpha L) at every late aperture, alpha >= 0, gives |Re rho - 1/2| <= alpha for every zero.
constraints.scope: Both parities.
countermodel_tests: FrontierMutation20 (rate 1 does not give Re rho = 1/2)
constraints.budget_improved: Records the exact zero-displacement implication of an exponential estimate.

constraints.name: (SB) cofinal one-constant floor and the all-late fixed-depth witnesses (AD)
constraints.statement: Exists C >= 0 such that for every R some L > max R 2 has a parity with Q_p >= -C ||u||^2 on the whole slice.
constraints.scope: Parity may switch per aperture, never per vector.
countermodel_tests: FrontierMutation22 (AD is fixed depth, not exp depth)
constraints.strength: If the native slice energy is the Weil form on the slice functions, RH implies Q >= 0 there, so this contract is also RH-necessary: a sharp interface (LEAD, not formalized). Only an independent supplier changes the state.
constraints.budget_improved: One finite constant, chosen once.

constraints.name: (C2-SE) literal long-term subexponential lower bound
constraints.statement: For every alpha > 0, T(t) >= -C exp(alpha t) at every late t, T the literal hyperbola long term.
constraints.scope: Literal scalar source; t = 2a.
constraints.parameter_order: alpha, then C and T; every late t.
countermodel_tests: FrontierMutation23 (rate 2 alpha in a, not alpha)
MP15 (product kernel is not the lcm Gram)
constraints.budget_improved: Constant floor relaxed to every positive rate.

constraints.name: (NC) native squared-index commutator cancellation and rank-one leakage
constraints.statement: V* [D0, A] V = 0 for boundary-flat columns (full canonical source); D0 maps each slice into pole-neutral boundary-flat vectors and leaves it exactly through M6 (even) or M7 (odd).
constraints.scope: Full canonical source, both carriers.
countermodel_tests: FrontierMutation25 (D0 does not preserve the slice)
MP19 (holds for arbitrary real prime weights)
constraints.budget_improved: Turns the compressed commutator into the rank-two z l* - l z*; supplies no sign.

constraints.name: (SG) geometry-diagonal and source-response growth (5A candidate)
constraints.statement: In one fixed parity, for all late L: ||V* E w|| <= C_z (1+L)^a and min_i <v_i, H v_i> >= -C_h (1+L)^b, with v_i the geometry eigenbasis of J = V* D0 V and w the unit leakage normal.
constraints.scope: Paper candidate from RH_Step4_Polynomial_Geometry_and_Source_Response_2026-11-08.md (TEXT_REVIEWED).
constraints.budget_improved: Reduces the all-vector bound to a geometry-diagonal family and one mixed response; the reduction loss 2 ||l|| ||z|| / g_J is polynomial but large (about 2e4 at L=4).
constraints.refinement: Real-gauge tightening (Centered Prime report): z may be replaced by z - t l for real t without changing z l* - l z*; the Lean bound accepts any z with the commutator relation.

constraints.name: (CP) centered ordinary-prime discrepancy lower bound
constraints.statement: In one fixed parity, for all late L and every slice vector f: D_theta(L, f) >= -C (1+L)^d ||f||^2, where Q_L = R_0 + D_theta - P_pp exactly, R_0 >= c_* ||f||^2 (c_* about -1.3722) and ||P_pp|| <= 2 L^2.
constraints.scope: Paper reduction (Centered Prime Continuation, 8 November, TEXT_REVIEWED).
constraints.native_validity: OPEN (reduction CP -> PG DERIVED, not formalized)
countermodel_tests: MP20 (positive PNT-envelope comparison density fails PG on the exact carrier)
constraints.budget_improved: Isolates the centered ordinary-prime tail; proper prime powers paid at 2 L^2.

constraints.name: CAUSAL: Abel-output membership at a damping sequence
constraints.statement: Distinct lambda_j > 0, lambda_j -> 0, with H_lambda_j in L2(0, infinity) for every j.
constraints.scope: Paper criterion (Abel Closure Attempt and Methodology Postmortem, 8 November).
constraints.parameter_order: a sequence; no uniform bound or rate.
constraints.falsified_shortcut: The global L2 first variation V = d/dlambda H at 0+ is not in L2 for the genuine source (critical-line zeros; DERIVED). This refutes the shortcut, not the membership target.
constraints.budget_improved: None; the dyadic covariance target of the 6 November reports remains the arithmetic gate.

constraints.name: Native rank-one leakage factor and rank-two compressed commutator
constraints.statement: D0 u - P_S D0 u = (M6(u)/||r_e||^2) r_e (even), (M7(u)/||r_o||^2) r_o (odd); <u, P D0 P A v - P A P D0 v> = c(v) conj<r, A u> - conj(c(u)) <r, A v> for the full canonical source.
constraints.scope: Both actual slices; ambient slices proved equal to the existing moment slices.
countermodel_tests: MP19 (holds for arbitrary real prime weights)
constraints.budget_improved: Completes the native application of M51 (U4); no sign.

constraints.name: Reconstruction bound and the (SG) certificate consumer
constraints.statement: Re x*Hx >= (h0 - 2 n_z n_l / g)||x||^2 under the rank-two relation; a geometry-response certificate gives the slice bound at its floor; polynomial certificates at every late aperture in one parity give PG and RH.
constraints.scope: Native slices; the certificate includes an orthonormal geometry eigenbasis, gap, diagonal, response and leakage numbers.
constraints.parameter_order: parity, C, d, L0 before L.
constraints.budget_improved: Entrywise Cauchy-Schwarz avoids a dimension factor; the K^2-scale loss of the leakage norm remains (5A).

constraints.name: Paid proper-prime-power adapter
constraints.statement: ||P_pp(L)|| <= 2 L^2 on either compressed slice; PG holds for the full source iff it holds for the primes-only source.
constraints.scope: Paper (Centered Prime Continuation, section 4), DERIVED; elementary (no PNT or RH).
countermodel_tests: CR26 (uncharged truncation fails near-positivity; compatible because the charge is paid)
constraints.budget_improved: Polynomial charge acceptable for PG, not for C1.

constraints.name: Unconditional explicit-PNT all-vector bound
constraints.scope: Paper (Centered Prime Continuation, section 7), DERIVED.
constraints.budget_improved: Stretched-exponential saving inside an exponential allowance; an x^(1/2+eta) error input would give rate eta.

strength_rule: An RH-sufficient contract that is also RH-necessary is a sharp interface, not independent sub-RH progress. Only an independent supplier changes the state.
